title: Rising Roots Black Futures Fund
summary: Grants of $2,500 to $10,000 to Black-led organizations and programs across Arizona that build community wealth, preserve Black history and culture, and develop Black youth leadership.
description: The Rising Roots Black Futures Fund was launched in 2021 by Black philanthropists in northern Arizona who wanted to increase investment in Black-led organizations and preserve the history of Black communities in the region, including the families who built Flagstaff's railroad and lumber industries.
Grants support Black-led nonprofits and grassroots groups statewide. First-time applicants and organizations with annual budgets under $250,000 are especially encouraged to apply.
impact_areas: Community and economic development in Black communities
Black artistic expression and preservation of cultural heritage
Black youth leadership and educational achievement
populations_served: Black residents and families in Arizona
Black entrepreneurs and small business owners

geography.summary: Applications are accepted from organizations serving communities anywhere in Arizona.

eligibility: Black-led 501(c)(3) organizations, or Black-led projects and grassroots groups with a qualified fiscal sponsor
Organizations not Black-led may apply for programs designed with and for Black communities, documented by a letter of partnership
One application per organization per year

how_to_apply.intro: Rising Roots uses a short, single-stage application. Applicants may submit written answers or a video of up to ten minutes.

steps.title: Read the RFP
steps.text: Download the Rising Roots Black Futures Fund 2027 Request for Proposals.

steps.title: Prepare the application
steps.text: Draft answers to the five application questions listed in the RFP, or record a video response.

steps.title: Submit
steps.text: Submit through the CPCF Grant Portal, or email materials to grants@cinderpeakscf.org with the subject line "Rising Roots – [Organization Name]", by 5:00 p.m. MST on January 29, 2027.

steps.title: Decision
steps.text: The Rising Roots Advisory Circle reviews applications in February. Applicants are notified by March 12, 2027.

review_criteria: Potential for lasting benefit to Black communities
Feasibility of the plan and budget

reporting.summary: Grantees submit a Community Impact Story Report at the end of the grant year.
items: A short narrative, photo, or video story describing results
